Online unboxing culture and social media are also cited as demand drivers even in markets without bricks-and-mortar luxury stores.

We've had some really good new developments as well in terms of new stock and new buildings for these luxury retailers to to call home. And as a result, we've seen, yeah, a real uptick in terms of what type of retail it is. A lot of it is watches, jewellery, bags... There's a lot of people with a lot of money still out there.
